rows.text: How's your experience with the official version? If you find it easy, you can go challenge the next world.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Apparently it's more difficult with stronger enemies. Screwllum said that, according to his model, you have a 60% chance of losing the first time, but it's not like you'll actually lose anything.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: You'll clear it sooner or later.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Are you folks really here to research Aeons?
What are you talking about? Our goals haven't changed. Now run off and get ready.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: This is feeling more and more like a real game...
